title: English · занятия
description: Сохранённые ответы NotesBot. Подход начинается после паузы больше 30 минут между ответами. Данные привязаны ко времени, когда сервер принял ответ.

panels.title: За выбранный период
panels.description: Ответы и уникальные карточки без пропусков. Подходы считаются по времени начала.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE action <> 'skip') AS "Ответы",
       count(DISTINCT card_id) FILTER (WHERE action <> 'skip') AS "Уникальные карточки",
       count(DISTINCT (reviewed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date)
           FILTER (WHERE action <> 'skip') AS "Дни с занятиями",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM english_report_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)) AS "Подходы"
FROM english_report_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(reviewed_at);

WITH dates AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow'),
        date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow'),
        interval '1 day'
    ) AS day
), totals AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('day', reviewed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow') AS day,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'miss') AS misses,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'hard') AS hard_answers,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'easy') AS easy_answers,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'skip') AS skips
    FROM english_report_events
    WHERE $__timeFilter(reviewed_at)
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT greatest(dates.day AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS time,
       coalesce(misses, 0) AS "Не вспомнил",
       coalesce(hard_answers, 0) AS "С трудом",
       coalesce(easy_answers, 0) AS "Легко",
       coalesce(skips, 0) AS "Пропустил"
FROM dates
LEFT JOIN totals USING (day)
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Карточки за подход
panels.description: Если одна карточка встретилась несколько раз, она учитывается во всех ответах и один раз в уникальных карточках.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time,
       attempts AS "Ответы",
       unique_cards AS "Уникальные карточки"
FROM english_report_sessions
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT started_at AS "Начало",
       ended_at AS "Последний ответ",
       attempts AS "Ответы",
       unique_cards AS "Уникальные карточки",
       misses AS "Не вспомнил",
       hard_answers AS "С трудом",
       easy_answers AS "Легко"
FROM english_report_sessions
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY started_at DESC;
